createcmpor.ponder.stress_input.text_1: The Stress Input block brings mechanical stress from outside into the room.
createcmpor.ponder.stress_input.text_2: IO blocks are activated during evaluation to provide items or stress.
createcmpor.ponder.stress_input.text_3: Once activated it acts as a stress source, providing rotation to connected machinery.
createcmpor.ponder.stress_output.text_1: The Stress Output block is a passive observer of the connected stress network.
createcmpor.ponder.stress_output.text_2: It records how much stress the network can supply for the factory's output.
createcmpor.ponder.stress_output.text_3: Once activated it observes the network and records the stress that the factory can supply.
createcmpor.ponder.input_block.text_1: The Input block is where items and fluids enter the room from outside.
createcmpor.ponder.input_block.text_2: Right-click with an item or bucket to set the whitelist; it activates during evaluation.
createcmpor.ponder.input_block.text_3: Once activated, whitelisted items flow down through the chute to the machines inside.
createcmpor.ponder.output_block.text_1: The Output block is where items and fluids leave the room to the outside.
createcmpor.ponder.output_block.text_2: Right-click with an item or bucket to set the whitelist; it activates during evaluation.
createcmpor.ponder.output_block.text_3: Once activated, whitelisted products from inside flow down to the Output block and leave the room.
createcmpor.ponder.io_extension.text_1: By default, all 6 faces of the factory block provide item/fluid/energy input and output.
createcmpor.ponder.io_extension.text_2: Opening a shaft interface with a Wrench makes that face lose its input/output ability.
createcmpor.ponder.io_extension.text_3: Place an IO Extension Block on the shaft face to extend the factory's item/fluid input and output to its other faces.
createcmpor.ponder.factory_machine.text_: A Compact Machines room machine is the starting point of evaluation.
Right-click the machine with the evaluation launcher to start evaluating the room.
createcmpor.ponder.factory_evaluator_sta: The machine becomes an evaluator block: the room is frozen and cloned into the evaluation world.
createcmpor.ponder.factory_solidified.te: Evaluation complete: the evaluator block solidifies into a parallel factory.
createcmpor.ponder.factory_running.text_: The factory keeps reproducing the production line, taking inputs and outputs through funnels.
Use a Wrench to right-click any face of the factory to open a shaft face for mechanical stress.
createcmpor.ponder.factory_reverted.head: Restore the Room Machine
createcmpor.ponder.factory_reverted.text: Right-click the factory with the evaluation launcher to restore the original Compact Machines machine.
After restoration the room is back to normal and can be entered or evaluated again.
